additional_info.body:
Dear Norbert,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R6 170002088
ChargerID/Serial No.
: CjuQJx
Problem Description
: All outlet out of order
Troubleshooting
:
It seems that there is a faulty converter on the charger
This converter[7] with serial number =
2102312VGQKXN9001437SA002218000000FW:DC116PF116H100
This converter needs replacement if you don't have a spare part at the moment with you, what you can do is remove the CAN cable from this converter and reboot the charger.
It should come online and working if there is no other problem.
Let me know your feedback.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0393748
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim

additional_info.subject: ID0393748-DC/Si-D/RS[CjuQJx] - All outlets unavailable CRM:00315002150
additional_info.body:
Hi Szilard,
After our site visit today we were able to fix the problem from the previous email but we found another converter with the same problem.
As you can see the converter is stuck in PowerOn=True and the voltage doesn't raise above 68V.
As you didn't have an extra power converter, we removed the CAN cable and now the charger is fully operational with only 20kW loss.
As you mentioned, this charger is very far and as such you will not replace this soon. So I will close the ticket and when you have the availability to change it please refer this ticket number again.
Thank you and have a nice weekend!
Best regards,
Francisco
